notes.zh: 审阅注：此菜单在三种情况下打开——首次接触完成或“通讯已建立”后（enclave.404），以及之后每次外交联络（enclave.400，on_custom_diplomacy）。服务选项返回本菜单，是可重复使用的服务枢纽，而非线性剧情。
notes.en: Review note: this menu opens after first contact or 'Communications Established' (enclave.404) and on every later diplomatic contact (enclave.400, on_custom_diplomacy). Service options return here: it is a repeatable service hub, not a linear chain.

notes.zh: 审阅注：“寻求虚境掌控”（enclave.405.i）打开子菜单 shroud.5300（继承本菜单标题，shroud_events.txt:17388）；六项子服务都回到该子菜单，5325/5330 付费后经 5326 再次打开它（以回指节点显示）。
notes.en: Review note: 'We seek mastery of the Shroud' (enclave.405.i) opens the submenu shroud.5300 (it inherits this window's title, shroud_events.txt:17388); its six sub-services return to it, and after paying 5325/5330 re-open it through 5326 (shown as return nodes).

notes.zh: 审阅注：支付后回到“虚境掌控”子菜单，并在10年后询问是否续约（shroud.5327）。
notes.en: Review note: after paying, the Shroud-mastery submenu re-opens, and a renewal request follows 10 years later (shroud.5327).

notes.zh: 审阅注：仅当曾在首次接触事件fircon.1212中听过“面纱旅人”的故事（first_contact_dlc_events.txt:711设置标记）且尚未揭秘时出现；打捞者城邦菜单也有同一询问，同样转到本窗口。
notes.en: Review note: only offered after hearing the Veilfarer's story in first-contact event fircon.1212 (flag set at first_contact_dlc_events.txt:711) and before the secret is revealed; the Salvager menu offers the same question and opens this same window.

notes.zh: 审阅注：采纳“大觉醒”传统（灵能或虚境版本）后360–1080天，若尚未联络虚境行者，则由其主动问候并建立通讯（01_psionics.txt:112；01_psionics_shroud.txt:166/201）。
notes.en: Review note: 360-1080 days after adopting the 'Great Awakening' tradition (psionic or Shroud version), the Shroudwalkers greet an empire they have no contact with yet and establish communications (01_psionics.txt:112; 01_psionics_shroud.txt:166/201).

scope.zh: 完整：入口与引见、九项服务及其子菜单/项目/局势结果、跨故事链接。
scope.en: Complete: entries and introduction, nine services with their submenu, project and situation results, cross-story links.
